creative_brief.emotional_promise: An angular little machine whose removable body lets you understand its elastic drive.
creative_brief.format_rationale: Eight rigid parts, adhesive setup, a removable shell and a replaceable loop need separate inventory, assembly and operation views. Two sheets can be folded for storage.
creative_brief.physical_format: Four A5 portrait pages, a two-sheet owner leaflet; no bleed, 12 mm safe margins.
teaching_arc: Recognise the car and its limits
Fit the loop and lock the shell
creative_brief.visual_motif: The car's long diagonal roofline becomes a sloping gold rule; numbered mechanical actions follow a straight reading path.

findings: Page 2 final assembly paragraph crowds the footer; six representative images should say eight pieces total.
Shell view is edge-on and the end-wheel socket is hard to identify.
Page 3 needs an underside latch locator and an elastic path that remains clear in grayscale.
Cover should state that printed fit and latch durability are untested.
resolved_changes: Moved inventory and assembly content upward and corrected the total-pieces wording.
Rotated the shell mesh illustration and shaded mesh faces to reveal the keyed wheel socket.
Added a high-contrast underside schematic with both elastic strands, hook endpoints, latch location, inward press and 4 mm forward shell slide; corrected the front-anchor leader.
Added untested printed-fit and latch-durability text on the cover.
Reviewed all four final pages in color and grayscale for reading order, assembly, operation, reset and care.
Repaired the deterministic PDF stream rejection by embedding the exact cover pixels as two lossless tiles; rechecked the corrected final color and grayscale packet.
Replaced ReportLab initial Helvetica with embedded Vera; every color and grayscale page and both contact sheets retained identical pixel hashes.
